says: In next/, when one process has two open jobs for the same hands key, jobs.take answers refused ambiguous every time, and no other call assigns a job, so neither job ever runs.
proof: gateway/JobAccess.ts:49 returns Result.fail("ambiguous") whenever more than one candidate matches the process and key; gateway/Jobs.ts:87 turns that into refused { reason: "ambiguous" } and returns before any jobs.take; jobs.take is the only call that writes a taken event (gateway/Jobs.ts, jobs/JobsLedger.ts take). A program update that returns two hands Cmds makes two open jobs for one process (runtime/Runner.ts saves each Cmd under its own id).
cost: A program that asks the hands twice in one step waits forever with no error; the hands client in P39 slice 4 can only hold and wait.
